goal: Design the smallest evidence-driven release path that moves only accepted AnyTour Design System 2.0 lanes from feature/search-core to main without bulk-merging unrelated branch divergence.
never_touch: product runtime files while this task is planning-only
invariants: feature/search-core is not bulk-merged into main
only already accepted DS2 behavior may enter a proposed release slice
each release slice has explicit dependencies and verification gates
branch divergence is handled by rebuilding narrow changes against current main rather than copying unrelated feature history

checks: inventory accepted runtime files and their main/feature divergence
prove each proposed release slice is limited to approved DS2 behavior
identify required main CI/deploy/post-deploy gates before any production write

done_when: no bulk feature/search-core merge is proposed
accepted runtime files are mapped to narrow release slices with explicit dependencies
protected Metrika, Tourvisor, pricing, lead transport and logo contracts remain outside the release diff
production deployment is deferred until the narrow implementation PRs are green on main and normal live gates are available
